Asset type: finished background illustration for a cheerful French word game's short winner animation. Generate ONE wide landscape image, 16:9 composition, ideally 1536x864 or higher.

The hopscotch alternates SINGLE squares and PAIRS of adjacent squares, connected closely in a real playable hopscotch arrangement. The path starts in the bottom foreground and recedes gently toward the upper middle, with only moderate perspective so the foreground letters and square shapes stay readable. The visible tiles have thick cream-colored faces, rounded cobalt/teal edges and large clean dark-blue uppercase letters: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H. One letter per tile, no other text. A few small, beautifully lit gold coins lie beside the path, never covering a letter. Soft warm golden side lighting, subtle atmospheric depth and a simple softly blurred blue-teal environment behind it.
Art direction: polished premium cartoon game illustration, charming tactile painted 3D forms, soft bevels and rich but restrained lighting, appealing and coherent, crisp readable shapes, not photoreal, not generic neon science fiction. Strong legibility and careful composition, no cheap flat CSS-like parallelograms, no abstract lettering.
Layout: top 23% calm dark teal negative space for live heading; center area relatively uncluttered to host one to three real player avatars composited separately. Clearly visible path in the lower half, safe quiet bottom edge for a live caption. Full-bleed background, no frame. The image must be attractive when displayed full screen on a computer. It will have a separate portrait adaptation for phones.
Absolutely NO people, NO heads, NO bodies, NO feet, NO legs, NO mascot, NO UI, NO score, NO amount, NO logo or watermark. Only the background and the letter hopscotch environment.
